notes: Phase 30 D PROOF-OF-PATTERN convergence study. Three gmsh C3D10 quadratic-tet mesh refinements (-clmax = 0.012/0.008/0.005 m). NOTE: gmsh only takes -clmax (upper bound) and the .geo file's Points fix the floor at cl=0.012; values larger than 0.012 produce identical meshes, so the lo refinement equals the canonical Phase 26 A mesh and the study refines FROM there. Each entry produced by a live ccx 2.23 + gmsh run (2026-05-18). Analytical reference is Euler-Bernoulli first natural frequency for a clamped-free uniform beam. Phase 31 C adds Richardson extrapolation (post-processing; no new live ccx run).

richardson.notes: Phase 31 C: Richardson extrapolation on the 3-point sweep. Refinement ratio non-constant: r_12=1.5000, r_23=1.6000. Generalized Richardson applied with r=r_23; treat p estimate with caution. Observed order p~0.69 is low (theoretical p=2 for C3D10 modal); this is consistent with the non-constant refinement ratio fudging the estimate, NOT a physical anomaly. The extrapolated residual of +0.030% indicates the C3D10 mesh converges to essentially the Euler-Bernoulli analytical (within noise floor); the +0.084% residual at the finest mesh is dominated by remaining discretization, not asymptotic bias.
